snippet.title: Sussy NPC Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Sussy NPC is a 2-10 multiplayer social stealth game about looking normal while someone watches.
One team hides. They are the crowd. Blend in, copy the NPCs around you, act like you belong. Complete objectives and escape the guards.
One team hunts. Guards watch, follow anyone who moves a little too purposeful, and run tests.
